description:
If you’re looking for some top-notch merino wool clothing that’s made right here in Aotearoa, then you’ll want to check out Smart Merino. They’ve got everything you need to keep you warm, comfy and stylish, from base layers and thermals to lingerie and accessories. And they’re not just for the winter, either. Merino wool is breathable, moisture-wicking and odour-resistant, so you can wear it all year round. Plus, it’s ethically sourced and traceable, so you can feel good about your purchase. Whether you’re into Brass Monkeys, Nature’s Secret or From Merino With Love, you’ll find something that suits you at Smart Merino. So don’t be a dag, head over to their website and get yourself some quality merino wool clothing today. You won’t regret it, mate!

13 ways you can use and promote our garments. 

  • Camping or backpacking: Merino base layers will be lightweight and easy to pack, and also durable and odor-resistant for multiple wears.
  • Working outdoors: Merino base layers will keep you warm in the winter and cool in the summer, and also resist stains and fire.
  • Traveling or commuting: Merino base layers will be versatile and stylish, and also easy to wash and dry on the go.
  • Hiking Everest base camp: Merino base layers will keep you warm and dry in the cold and windy conditions, and help regulate your body temperature as you ascend and descend.
  • Skiing or snowboarding: Merino base layers will provide insulation and breathability under your outerwear, and prevent chafing and irritation from your gear.
  • Running or cycling: Merino base layers will wick away sweat and moisture from your skin, and keep you comfortable in various weather conditions.
  • Fishing or hunting: Merino base layers will blend in with the natural environment, and protect you from insects and UV rays.
  • Lounging or sleeping: Merino base layers will be soft and cozy, and also regulate your body temperature throughout the night.
  • Recovering or healing: Merino base layers will promote blood circulation and reduce inflammation, and also soothe sensitive skin.
  • Climbing or mountaineering: Merino base layers will offer high performance and durability, and also prevent blisters and abrasions from your equipment.
  • Golfing or tennis: Merino base layers will enhance your range of motion and comfort, and also absorb sweat and odor from your body.
  • Gardening or landscaping: Merino base layers will shield you from dirt and dust, and also keep you cool and dry in the sun.
